data.raw_text:
Starting Wednesday, April 1, 2026, Japan Airlines (JL) will operate at the Ninoy Aquino International Airport (NAIA) Terminal 3 from NAIA Terminal 1.

Other international airlines that operate at NAIA Terminal 3 were:

Air China (CA)

All Nippon Airways (NH)

Cathay Pacific (CX)

Cebu Pacific (5J)

China Eastern (MU)

China Southern Airlines (CZ)

Emirates (EK)

Ethiopian Airlines (ET)

Etihad Airways (EY)

Greater Bay Airline (HB)

Gulf Air (GF)

Hong Kong Express (UO)

Jeju Air (7C)

Jetstar Japan (JQ)

KLM Royal Dutch Airlines (KL)

Qantas (QF)

Qatar Airways (QR)

Thai Airways (TG)

Turkish Airlines (TK)

Royal Brunei Airlines (BI)

Scoot (TR)

Shenzhen Airline (ZH)

Vietnam Airlines (VN)

Singapore Airlines (SQ)

Air France (AF)

United Airlines (UA)

Air Canada (AC).

International airlines that operate at NAIA Terminal 1 were:

Philippine Airlines (PR)

AirAsia Philippines (Z2)

AirAsia Berhad (AK)

Air Niugini (PX)

Asiana Airlines (OZ)

China Airlines (CI)

Eva Air (BR)

Korean Air (KE)

Kuwait Airways (KU)

Malaysian Air (MH)

Oman Air (WY)

Saudia (SV)

Xiamen Air (MF)

VietJet Air (VJ)

Air India (AI).

The airline terminal assignments are part of NAIA’s move to reduce congestion and improve passenger flow and to avoid confusion on which terminal to go.

The announcements were made by the New NAIA Infrastructure Corporation (NNIC) and the Manila International Airport Authority (MIAA). | via Rudy Santos
